{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Identify the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False)
trial_df = trial_df.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Filter for patients with severe disease
severe_df = trial_df[trial_df['severity'] == 'severe']

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_value = -999.0
print("Count of sentinel values in biomarker_baseline for severe patients:", (severe_df['biomarker_baseline'] == sentinel_value).sum())

# Check the actual values
print("Unique values in biomarker_baseline for severe patients:", severe_df['biomarker_baseline'].unique())"}
